about: The differences between the Node server and the Rust server that the specification declares, one entry per request or path, each naming its row of the table in docs/specs/2026-11-27-mcp-server-in-rust.md. A run fails when an entry no longer differs. Unlike the other known-difference lists this one grows with the table; an entry without a row and a reason is refused.
